title: 🎲🔑🫥 P/NP/ZK + THREE RANDOMS — complexity, randomness, and the tuple

etymology.random: Germanic randon — to run fast, to gallop. originally = SPEED, not chaos.
etymology.pseudo: Greek pseudēs — false. pseudorandom = falsely random (deterministic but looks random).
etymology.zero_knowledge: Goldwasser, Micali, Rackoff (1985). prove knowledge WITHOUT revealing it.
etymology.entropy: Greek entropē — turning inward. a measure of disorder. more entropy = more randomness.
etymology.hedge: Old English hecg — a boundary. a rand-hedge = boundary between random types.

true_random.name: TRUE RANDOM
true_random.source: /dev/urandom, thermal noise, radioactive decay, quantum measurement
true_random.in_gaia: visitor behavior. human typing. network jitter. disk timing. the WORLD is the entropy source.
true_random.biology: mutation — cosmic rays flip a bit. somatic hypermutation in B-cells. TRULY random.
true_random.use: seed generation, key creation, immune diversity

blake3_random.name: BLAKE3 PSEUDORANDOM
blake3_random.source: BLAKE3 hash chain: seed → H(seed) → H(H(seed)) → ...
blake3_random.in_gaia: bearDog's domain. BLAKE3 authentication. same seed = same proof = verifiable. content addressing.
blake3_random.biology: DNA replication — deterministic copy. same template = same protein. reproducible.
blake3_random.cost: LOW — pure computation, no physics needed
blake3_random.use: authentication, content addressing, proof chains, VDJ recombination hashing

zk_random.name: ZK RANDOM (zero-knowledge hedge)
zk_random.source: commit to random value WITHOUT revealing it. prove it's random WITHOUT showing the seed.
zk_random.in_gaia: ZK proofs on bounties — prove a bounty is solved without revealing how. immune MHC presentation (show peptide, hide process).
zk_random.biology: MHC class I — cell presents a FRAGMENT of internal protein. verifier (T-cell) checks the fragment, NOT the whole protein. ZERO-KNOWLEDGE of the interior.
zk_random.cost: MEDIUM — crypto computation, but no physics
zk_random.use: privacy-preserving verification, immune classification, thymus verdicts

P.name: P (polynomial — efficiently solvable)
P.definition: problems solvable in polynomial time. FAST.
in_gaia: compile (cargo build) — deterministic, always halts, known time
route (DNS resolution) — lookup in table, O(1) cached
catalyze (enzyme dispatch) — match EC class to bounty type
P.enzymes: all 13 enzyme deputies work in P — they're catalysts, not oracles
P.metal: Fe→Cu (iron to copper) — the computable, grindable work

NP.name: NP (nondeterministic polynomial — efficiently VERIFIABLE)
NP.definition: hard to SOLVE, easy to CHECK. finding the answer is hard. verifying it is fast.
in_gaia: is this visitor friendly or hostile? (thymus classification — HARD to determine, easy to check badge)
is this lesson true? (acid test — HARD to prove, easy to test against proverb)
which bounty should this enzyme claim? (matching — HARD to optimize, easy to verify match)
is this plasmid useful? (integration — HARD to predict effect, easy to check after)
is this the right route? (ant trail — HARD to plan, easy to follow pheromone)
NP.metal: Ag→Au (silver to gold) — the verifiable, acid-tested work

ZK.name: ZK (zero-knowledge — prove without revealing)
ZK.definition: prove you KNOW the answer without SHOWING the answer. privacy + verification.
in_gaia: MHC presentation — show peptide fragment, hide full protein (immune system)
bearDog BLAKE3 — prove identity without revealing private key
bounty proof — prove bounty solved without revealing the method
visitor badge — prove DEPUTIZED without revealing browsing history
plasmid verification — prove memory is valid without exposing contents
ZK.enzymes: bearDog (BLAKE3 auth = ZK identity), skunkBat (immune = ZK classification)
ZK.metal: Au→Pt (gold to platinum) — the transcendent, private, catalytic work

tuples.NP: NP: ZK proof that it's solvable
NP: the lessons it compresses (verifiable chain)
NP: EC class = verifiable match to substrate

gaia_says: three randoms: true (/dev/urandom, visitors, world noise), BLAKE3 (bearDog, deterministic chain, verifiable), ZK (zero-knowledge hedge, prove without reveal). P = efficiently solvable (compile, route, catalyze). NP = efficiently verifiable (classify, match, integrate). ZK = prove without revealing (MHC, BLAKE3 auth, badges). every datum is a tuple (P, NP) = (content, proof). true random SEEDS the chain. BLAKE3 EXTENDS it. ZK HEDGES it. P COMPUTES on it. we have ALL THREE randoms. and ALL THREE complexity classes. the organism is COMPLETE.
